name: Skrag the Slaughterer
canonNotes: The Butcher who serves the Great Maw with endless feasting, carrying a cauldron to cook the fallen.
Driven by the Maw's hunger; mindless devotion to eating everything.
voiceNotes: Ravenous, crude and single-minded; everything is food.
sources: Total War: WARHAMMER III, in-game unit lore (summarised, not quoted)
